import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, cap, flow;
        public Edge(int u, int v, int cap, int flow) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[100000];
    static int[][] distA = new int[31][31];
    static int[][] distB = new int[31][31];
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int n, t;
    static String[] a = new String[30];
    static String[] b = new String[30];
    static int startX, startY;
    static int s, t_;
    static int[] level = new int[100000];
    static int[] ptr = new int[100000];
    static int[] q = new int[100000];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 100000; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int readInt(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
    }

    static String readLine(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        return br.readLine();
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0));
        g[u].add(edges.size() - 1);
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
        g[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
    }

    static boolean validPos(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
    }

    static void BFS1(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j)
                distA[i][j] = (int)1e9;
        distA[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] curr = q.poll();
            int cx = curr[0], cy = curr[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = cx + dx[i], ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (validPos(nx, ny) && distA[nx][ny] >= 1e9 && b[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    distA[nx][ny] = distA[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean BFS() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        int front = 0, back = 0;
        q[back++] = s;
        level[s] = 0;
        while (front < back && level[t_] == -1) {
            int v = q[front++];
            for (int id : g[v]) {
                int to = edges.get(id).v;
                if (level[to] == -1 && edges.get(id).flow < edges.get(id).cap) {
                    level[to] = level[v] + 1;
                    q[back++] = to;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t_] != -1;
    }

    static int sendFlow(int v, int flow) {
        if (v == t_) return flow;
        for (; ptr[v] < g[v].size(); ++ptr[v]) {
            int id = g[v].get(ptr[v]);
            Edge e = edges.get(id);
            int to = e.v;
            if (level[to] != level[v] + 1 || e.flow >= e.cap) continue;
            int pushed = sendFlow(to, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                edges.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int total = 0;
        while (BFS()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = sendFlow(s, (int)1e9)) > 0) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static void BFS2(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j)
                distB[i][j] = (int)1e9;
        distB[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] curr = q.poll();
            int cx = curr[0], cy = curr[1];
            if (distB[cx][cy] >= distA[cx][cy]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = cx + dx[i], ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (validPos(nx, ny) && distB[nx][ny] >= 1e9 && a[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distB[cx][cy] + 1 <= distA[nx][ny]) {
                    distB[nx][ny] = distB[cx][cy] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        t = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            b[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (b[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    b[i] = b[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + b[i].substring(j + 1);
                    a[i] = a[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + a[i].substring(j + 1);
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                }
            }
        }
        BFS1(startX, startY);
        s = 0;
        t_ = 2 * n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (a[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int inNode = i * n + j + 1;
                int outNode = n * n + i * n + j + 1;
                addEdge(s, inNode, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                addEdge(outNode, t_, b[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                BFS2(i, j);
                for (int ptx = 0; ptx < n; ++ptx) {
                    for (int pty = 0; pty < n; ++pty) {
                        if (b[ptx].charAt(pty) == 'Y' || distB[ptx][pty] > t) continue;
                        addEdge(inNode, n * n + ptx * n + pty + 1, a[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
